_about: Hand-edited model for porting/progress/progress.py. Leaves with a "measure" are computed; leaves with kind "manual" use the pct you set, with rationale. Weights are manual effort estimates (relative points, roughly engineer-weeks) and set the treemap area. Edit a weight or pct, commit, and the post-commit hook regenerates the dashboard. Basis ladder, most objective first: git (computed from tracked files, replayable per commit), local (computed from git-ignored outputs), documented (typed count), manual (typed percent). Denominators come from porting/progress/totals.json; checks from porting/progress/evidence.json. See README 'Objectivity audit'.
definition: 100% = the entire game can be launched into the menu, joined into a game and matchmade on the reconstructed server, and played with sound/audio and visuals 100% working. In other words: the client — the exact same client as the 12.60 original, feature-complete and unstripped, rebuilt as a UE project — reaches the lobby, matchmakes to the reconstructed UE dedicated server (which carries every structure and feature the original dedicated server would have) and plays a match with all visuals and audio. The supplied 12.60 build is the completeness reference; the original binary under Wine is an analysis oracle, not the deliverable.

children.name: Local username and account behavior
children.rationale: The local service selects persistent accounts by username without passwords, entitlement checks or anti-cheat. HTTP tests cover account selection and restart persistence; unknown exchange codes are rejected instead of silently choosing another account. An exclusive state-directory lock prevents concurrent backend processes from owning the same persistent state. The original sign-in widget now has a generated username-only adaptation backed by token selection and a validated Athena profile snapshot. A focused HTTP test covers distinct persistent lockers. These native changes are build pending. Original profile-initializer dispatch, borrowed string lifetime and support-field ownership are traced. Three explicit-state timer-context helpers are now promoted as source, with native build/runtime checks pending; group ownership integration remains unfinished. The original login parent directly selects its existing credentials child. Game-service URL fields and constructor defaults are recovered, and object creation is identified as a multicast broadcast rather than manager registration. The URL precondition checks SSL domain pinning and https/wss, requests process exit on failure, then continues assembly if the exit request returns. Configuration section/key mappings and state fields are recovered, but discovery/override precedence and the deployed game-service endpoint remain open. Callback effects, full MCP manager integration, frontend loading and online login remain unfinished or unverified. The remaining effort estimate needs review.

children.name: Original frontend material map decoding
children.rationale: Six original resources now parse to exact EOF with 118 shader records. The original Paper2D parent contributes 28 records, including five stages in three pipelines; its instance contributes 14. All records match the original archive, and both cooked markers are consumed. The 42 Paper2D occurrences reference 33 distinct archive shaders; all 33 convert and pass SPIR-V validation, with 163 explicit descriptors and zero unmatched resource-table entries. A strict manifest exporter retains all occurrences and pipeline references. A separate LocalVF/mesh/pipeline map factory is implemented in an Engine patch, and the native reader retains the observed Paper2D records and ordered pipelines. An output-construction kernel now validates independent original/current uniform metadata and complete descriptor/loose allocation contracts before producing Vulkan headers. Full original View recovery independently reproduces shader resource hashes, but exposes a 3952-versus-4032-byte layout difference from current source. The original 64-byte/eight-member LocalVF layout matches current source and all 15 active wrapper hashes; a typed producer checks registered metadata before publication. Legacy hash derivation and table-bit consistency are now enforced independently of current header hashes. Physical SPIR-V View analysis traces 133 constant loads: 11 shaders retain matching loaded offsets/shapes, while 19 require shifted-member or unmapped-lane work and three wrappers do not identify View. Original TranslucentDepthPass is independently decoded at 496 bytes versus 512 in current source. Compilation is pending; proven View/pass binding compatibility or remapping, provider attachment, texture binding, original frontend loading and rendering parity remain unfinished. See porting/material_pipeline/README.md.
